description: 芯矩慧科技风 - 深藏青 + 亮青色 + 彩色卡片，现代感少儿科技教育风格，适合课程/产品/科技类文章

styles.body: font-family: -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; color: #27314D; line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.3px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #FFFFFF; max-width: 677px; margin: 0 auto;
styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: #1A2456; text-align: center; margin: 38px 0 24px; padding: 0 0 16px 0; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 1.4; border-bottom: 2px solid #00D4FF;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: #1A2456; margin: 36px 0 16px; padding: 0 0 10px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #007E99; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #1A2456; margin: 28px 0 12px; padding: 0 0 0 14px; border-left: 4px solid #00D4FF; letter-spacing: 0.5px; line-height: 1.5;
styles.p: margin: 18px 0; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify; color: #27314D; line-height: 1.85; font-size: 15.5px;
styles.blockquote: margin: 26px 0; padding: 18px 18px 18px 20px; background: #F4F8FC; border-left: 4px solid #00D4FF; border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; color: #27314D; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.85;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 14px; margin: 18px auto 6px; display: block;
styles.code_inline: background: #F4F8FC; color: #007E99; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Menlo', 'Consolas', monospace;
styles.code_block: background: #0B1026; color: #D6DDF2; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.7; font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Menlo', 'Consolas', monospace; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre; margin: 24px 0; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
styles.ol: margin: 20px 0; padding-left: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: list;
styles.li_bullet: color: #00D4FF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 8px; text-align: left;
styles.li_number: color: #007E99; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; min-width: 22px; display: inline-block; margin-right: 10px;
styles.hr: border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #00D4FF, transparent); margin: 40px 0;
styles.a: color: #007E99; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,126,153,0.4);
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 24px 0; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #DCE7F1; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; table-layout: fixed; word-break: break-word;
styles.th: background: #0B1026; color: #F7FAFF; padding: 12px 14px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; word-break: break-word; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.td: padding: 11px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E8EFF7; color: #27314D; font-size: 13px; word-break: break-word; line-height: 1.6;
styles.caption: font-size: 12px; color: #8A94A6; text-align: center; margin: 9px 4px 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.section_divider: text-align: center; color: #00D4FF; letter-spacing: 10px; font-size: 14px; margin: 16px 0 34px; user-select: none;

list_style.label: A · 亮青色科技风
list_style.num_container: display: inline-block; color: #007E99; font-family: -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; margin-right: 10px; min-width: 22px; line-height: 1; vertical-align: -2px;
list_style.bullet_container: display: inline-block; color: #00D4FF; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 10px; margin-right: 10px; font-weight: 700;
